name: Gretchen Whitmer

lean.basis: Democratic state legislator (2001–2015) and Democratic governor of Michigan since 2019; DNC vice chair 2021–2025. By 2025 she called herself a centrist Democrat.

current_role: Governor of Michigan (since 2019; term-limited, leaves office in January 2027)
summary: Gretchen Whitmer has been the Democratic governor of Michigan since 2019 after 14 years in the state legislature, and is term-limited out in January 2027. She was a national co-chair of Joe Biden's 2020 campaign and a finalist to be his running mate. In Trump's second term she has worked with him on Michigan priorities, which drew criticism from some Democrats; on May 28, 2026 she said she would not run for president in 2028, then walked it back hours later.

sources.title: Michigan Gov. Whitmer says she won't run for president in 2028, then backtracks hours later — WTOP (AP)

timeline.role: State senator; Senate Democratic leader from 2011

connections.name: Joe Biden
connections.description: Whitmer endorsed Biden days before Michigan's March 2020 primary and became a national co-chair of his campaign; she was one of the finalists he considered for running mate.

connections.name: Kamala Harris
connections.description: When Biden withdrew in July 2024, Whitmer said she would not seek the nomination and endorsed Harris.

connections.name: Donald Trump
connections.description: In 2020 Whitmer criticized Trump's pandemic response and Trump reportedly told Pence "don't call the woman in Michigan." In his second term relations warmed: after an April 2025 Oval Office visit where she hid her face from cameras, Trump credited her when he announced a new fighter mission for Michigan's Selfridge base.

sources.title: Trump praises Gov. Gretchen Whitmer while announcing new fighter jets — NBC News
Trump announces new fighter jet mission at Michigan air base alongside Gov. Whitmer — Michigan Public

connections.name: Abdul El-Sayed
connections.description: Whitmer beat El-Sayed in the 2018 Democratic primary for governor, 52% to 30%.

connections.name: Ken Martin
connections.description: Both served as vice chairs of the Democratic National Committee from 2021 until Martin became chair in 2025.
